channel.title: Ubiquiti, Inc. — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by Ubiquiti, Inc. (ubiquiti).

item.title: CVE-2026-77532 · 9.6 CRITICAL
item.description: A malicious actor with access to an adjacent network could exploit a Buffer Overflow vulnerability found in a DHCPv6-enabled EdgeMAX EdgeSwitch to initiate a Remote Code Execution on such device.

item.title: CVE-2026-77557 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️
